metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills — daily-driver tooling for desktop maintenance, dotfiles, home LAN, secrets, and post-update repair. A live, directory-source marketplace.

plugins.name: bitwarden-cli
plugins.description: Bitwarden workflows for both CLIs — bw (vault: secure notes, SSH keys) and bws (Secrets Manager: machine tokens, projects, runtime injection).

plugins.name: home-network
plugins.description: Home LAN discovery, troubleshooting, ufw, and self-healing device inventory via background claude -p agents.

plugins.name: home-assistant
plugins.description: Operate self-hosted Home Assistant safely — safe-mutation discipline, a secret-safe inventory snapshot with drift detection (ha-inventory), and append-only gotcha capture (ha-note).

plugins.name: cron-claude
plugins.description: Schedule recurring claude -p jobs as systemd user timers.

plugins.name: hypr-doctor
plugins.description: Post-update triage and repair for the Arch/CachyOS Hyprland desktop.

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: Dotfiles management with chezmoi — apply/diff, templating, age encryption.

plugins.name: universal-directory-organizer
plugins.description: Interactive directory cleanup and organization with safety hooks.

plugins.name: agentic-engineering
plugins.description: Evidence-based guide to prompt, context, agent, and loop engineering for frontier LLM agents — theory plus orchestrator-worker, tool-design, and caching practice.

plugins.name: wow-addon-management
plugins.description: Manage World of Warcraft retail addons on Linux — GitHub-release + CurseForge downloads with a Firecrawl reconciliation guard, relative-symlink management, library fetching, BugGrabber analysis, and gamescope display setup. Drives the tooling in ~/repos/WoW.
